hints.title: A range is a difference
hints.body: If you knew the total of every prefix of `weights`, how could you describe the total of a range that starts after the first prefix and ends at the second?

hints.title: Rearrange the subtraction
hints.body: A range ending at position `i` has total `running - earlier`, where `running` is the prefix total through `i`. You need this total to equal `target`, so you need `earlier = running - target`.

hints.title: Count, do not search
hints.body: Keep a map from each prefix total to how many times it has appeared. Seed it with total `0` occurring once, for the empty prefix. For each value, add the count of `running - target` to the answer, then record the new `running`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
counts = {0: 1}
running = 0
answer = 0
for value in weights:
    running = running + value
    answer = answer + counts.get(running - target, 0)
    counts[running] = counts.get(running, 0) + 1
return answer
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Translate it into your language and test it on the examples.
